svg.aria-label: EditsMaker against other editors. Download: EditsMaker 3.7 MB (Windows 3.7, Linux 3.7, macOS 3.4), auto-editor 46 MB, HyperFrames about 360 MB with its Chrome, CapCut about 510 MB, Descript about 654 MB, Filmora about 810 MB, DaVinci Resolve about 1.7 GB, Premiere Pro and After Effects 8 GB each to install. EditsMaker is the only one that is free, open source, built for AI agents, reads TikTok's trending songs, takes footage from a link and reverse-engineers any edit into a preset.
